oneLiner: A decision log that tracks what was decided, why, and when.
problem: Teams and individuals struggle to remember the reasoning behind past decisions, leading to repeated debates, inconsistent choices, and institutional knowledge loss when people leave.
targetUser: Product managers, engineering leads, and team decision-makers at small to mid-sized organizations
coreFlow: User creates a new decision entry with title, outcome, and rationale
System auto-captures timestamp and decision maker
User tags decision with category, status, and affected teams
User searches or filters past decisions by date, category, or keyword
User reviews decision context before revisiting similar choices

screens.name: Decision Feed
screens.purpose: Homepage showing recent decisions with date, title, and decision maker for quick scanning

screens.name: Create Decision
screens.purpose: Form to log a new decision with fields for title, outcome, rationale, and tags

screens.name: Decision Detail
screens.purpose: Full view of a past decision showing all context, rationale, stakeholders, and ability to add follow-up notes

screens.name: Search & Filter
screens.purpose: Interface to find decisions by category, date range, decision maker, or keyword

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Team workspace management, custom categories, and user permissions

outOfScope: Real-time collaboration or comments on decisions
Integration with external tools or calendar systems
Advanced analytics or decision performance metrics
